title: bounce-agents-off-each-other
description: Kilo-via-MiniMax 2.5 and Claude can go back and forth and find different things.  I would like to experiment with having them "talk to each other" where they argue a bit as part of refinement.  I think I somewhat can do this by simply having the plan reviewer be AgentA and the planner be AgentB.  Any other ideas for how we might be able to implement this better?
